watchlist.about: The Seattle Seahawks are the National Football League team based in Seattle.
The Seattle Mariners are the Major League Baseball team based in Seattle.
The Seattle Kraken are the National Hockey League team based in Seattle.
Seattle Sounders FC is the Major League Soccer team based in Seattle.
The Seattle Storm are the WNBA basketball team based in Seattle.
Seattle Reign FC is the National Women's Soccer League team based in Seattle.
The Washington Huskies are the University of Washington's college football team.
The Washington State Cougars are Washington State University's college football team.
Mount Rainier is the highest mountain in Washington.
Mount St. Helens is an active volcano in southwest Washington.
Washington State Ferries runs the public ferry system on Puget Sound.
The Space Needle is an observation tower in Seattle.
The Washington State Fair is held each year in Puyallup.
Snoqualmie Pass carries Interstate 90 over the Cascade Range.
Grey's Anatomy is a medical drama television series set in Seattle.
